channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Akira's Tweaks
item.description: Collection of patches for a personal server.

item.title: Antique Harmony | Music Additions / Alternative Soundtrack
item.description: Adds to/replaces soundtrack with original orchestral one, written for the game.

item.title: FuelRework
item.description: Increases the burn time of most fuels.

item.title: Racial Equality Height Patch
item.description: Simple patch to the Racial Equality mod that allows a wider range of height options.

item.title: Bushmeat Recipe
item.description: Adds bushmeat (raw and salted) to meals.

item.title: Magnetic Crown
item.description: Crown that attracts all nearby items

item.title: Alloy Calculator by Stuzzichino
item.description: Client-side alloy and fuel calculator for metallurgy and modded ingot configurations.

item.title: Self-Recording Thermometer
item.description: Adds a self-recording thermometer

item.title: Egg Pie (Quiche)
item.description: Allows eggs in pies

item.title: Alarm Timer
item.description: Adds a simple alarm timer command `.tm` (No server install needed)

item.title: No Screenshot Message
item.description: Disables "Screenshot ***.png taken." chat message (No server install needed)

item.title: Simple Blobcat
item.description: Adds a simple companion blobcat

item.title: Fix English Font (Windows only)
item.description: Playing VS in English but the text looks awkward? This mod fixes that! (No server install needed)

item.title: Antler Util
item.description: Helps you collecting antlers (also would work as a workaround for the "phantom" shed antlers issue)

item.title: Command Block Client Extension
item.description: Enables client commands in the Command Blocks (+ some utilities!)

item.title: Wood Mushrooms in Planters
item.description: Lets you place wood-growing mushrooms in planters/flowerpots

item.title: No Music Interruption
item.description: Prevents surface music interruption caused by rifts and caves (No server install needed)

item.title: One Strike Prospecting
item.description: Reduces prospecting sample requirement from 3 to 1

item.title: Beam Tweaks
item.description: Allows beam ends to overlap reliably (+ some fixes)

item.title: Trader Phone (Beta)
item.description: Let's make a call to traders and check their stocks!

item.title: Scoop of Jam
item.description: Scoop jam with a spoon to make jam sandwiches and jam pies!

item.title: More Bolts
item.description: Add more bolts for Combat Overhaul

item.title: Bricks & Blooms Server Tweaks
item.description: Solves conflicts between various mods for the Bricks and Bloom server.

item.title: The Crown & The Coalition Server Tweaks
item.description: Server tweaks for The Crown & The Coalition.

item.title: frontier cartography patch
item.description: this mod removes redundancy between craftable cartography and frontiers map sextant/map items

item.title: Display Container Versatility
item.description: Allows more items to be displayed on storage blocks.

item.title: The Almanac: Trades, Callings & Mastery
item.description: Twenty-one trades, Novice to Grandmaster, earned by the work of your hands, not by grinding.

item.title: Scribe: Notes & Tasks
item.description: Take notes and track tasks in-world. Pin tasks to a persistent HUD. Multiplayer-ready.

item.title: Wider Settings UI
item.description: Fixes the in-game settings window background being narrower than its controls

item.title: VS Instruments Redux
item.description: Bring your world to life! Play custom ABC sheet music files on working in-game instruments.
